one_liner_ko: 비동기 코드를 단계(step)로 감싸 실패해도 이어서 실행되게 하는 오픈소스 내구 실행(durable execution) 플랫폼.
what_it_does_ko: Inngest는 워크플로와 에이전트를 오케스트레이션 인프라 관리 없이 내구성 있게 실행하는 플랫폼이다. 기존 코드의 함수에 단계를 추가하면 Inngest가 각 단계를 실행·저장하고 실패한 단계부터 재시도한다. 흐름 제어, 관측(트레이스), 격리 샌드박스(microVM), 에이전트 평가·A/B 테스트를 함께 제공한다. TypeScript·Python·Go SDK와 REST API를 제공하며 로컬 Dev Server로 개발한 뒤 클라우드나 자체 호스팅 서버로 운영한다.
key_features: 내구 실행 안에서 격리 microVM 코드 실행(Sandboxes)
use_cases_ko: 도구 호출·사람 대기·장애 복구가 필요한 AI 에이전트 루프
실패한 단계만 재시도하는 다단계 백그라운드 작업

evidence.quote: Durable Execution for Workflows & AI | Inngest
Inngest is the fastest way to orchestrate all your async code.
Open source durable execution
Inngest is the platform for building durable workflows and agents that survive failures, without managing orchestration infrastructure.
Inngest runs each step, saves its result, and retries failed work from the step that failed.
TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs, plus the REST API.
Automatic retries, recovery, and observability.
Durable message queues without the infrastructure
Run scheduled and cron jobs as functions that sleep, fan out, parallelize, retry, and recover.
Control concurrency, throughput, and fairness across tenants.
Run code in isolated microVMs as part of a durable run.
Score outcomes and compare changes to steps and workflows.
Stream progress from durable runs to your users.
Trace every background job, agent, and event from trigger to completion
Run agent loops that call tools, wait for people, and survive failures.
Run multi-step jobs that retry each failed step, not the whole job.
Score real outcomes and compare prompts, models, and workflows.
Generous monthly limits to prove it before production. No credit card required.
500k events ingested
Inngest is an open source SDK for orchestrating event-driven apps and agents.
TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs, plus the REST API.
